class.name: Controls
class.brief_description: Local action values and pointer controls attached from code.
class.description: Call [method boot] on an existing scene owner. The framework admits gameplay presses after Godot UI and publishes action values before gameplay physics callbacks. Each owner retains independent bindings and input state.

method.name: axis
method.description: Returns this physics tick's scalar level in the range [-1, 1]. An unavailable, neutral, or differently typed action returns zero.

method.name: boot
method.description: Attaches controls to an owner already inside the scene tree. Without a layout, imports button actions from Godot's Input Map. The default keyboard and mouse player can also use the first available gamepad. Use an explicit nonnegative gamepad ID for a gamepad-only scope. Equivalent calls on the same owner return the same handle. Use [method get_error] to inspect a failed attachment.

method.name: capture_pointer
method.description: Captures the focused desktop pointer immediately. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when capture is unavailable, suspended, or disabled and [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] when another scope owns it.

method.name: close
method.description: Retires this attachment, restores the visible pointer if owned, and releases its input device assignment. Owner exit also retires the attachment.

method.name: for_node
method.description: Returns the nearest live controls attached to this node or an ancestor, or [code]null[/code] when there is none.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns the attachment's original error code. Check [method is_ready] to observe later retirement.

method.name: get_layout
method.description: Returns the original layout resource, or [code]null[/code] for a project Input Map scope or retired handle. Editing the resource affects later boots.

method.name: get_owner
method.description: Returns the live scene owner, or [code]null[/code] after retirement or failed boot.

method.name: has_action_kind
method.description: Reports whether this local scope has the requested action and type.

method.name: held
method.description: Reports this physics tick's held state for a button. Unavailable and differently typed actions read as [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Reports whether this exact attachment is live.

method.name: is_map_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the named action map is enabled for this player. Returns [code]false[/code] for unknown maps or a retired scope. UI suspension does not change this setting.

method.name: is_suspended
method.description: Reports whether a watched menu, exclusive rebinding capture, loss of focus, or retirement has neutralized these controls.

method.name: motion
method.description: Returns the sum of admitted relative pointer motion for the current physics tick, in unscaled screen pixels. Reading the value leaves it available to other readers. Unavailable and differently typed actions read as zero.

method.name: off_press
method.description: Disconnects the exact callback from this action. An unknown action returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: on_press
method.description: Registers a no-argument callback once for this button. Dispatch occurs before gameplay physics callbacks. An invalid callback or nonbutton action returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: pointer_captured
method.description: Reports whether this local scope owns the captured desktop pointer.

method.name: pressed
method.description: Reports whether an admitted button press occurred for the current physics tick. A quick tap may set both press and release.

method.name: release_pointer
method.description: Immediately makes the pointer visible if owned by this scope. Pending button edges and relative motion are cleared. Releasing twice is safe.

method.name: released
method.description: Reports whether the logical button became released for the current physics tick.

method.name: set_pointer_available
method.description: Enables or disables pointer capture permission for this scope. Disabling immediately releases a held pointer and clears pending input. Enabling allows a later capture request.

method.name: set_map_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables a named action group for this local player. Gameplay is enabled at boot, including when empty. Other [InputActionMap] resources start disabled. All enabled maps receive their bindings. If the same control appears in two enabled maps, both can respond. Changing state immediately clears that map's values and queued edges without emitting a release. Held controls must return to neutral before contributing again. Bindings and callbacks remain registered. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] for an unknown map, or [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] for an inactive scope.

method.name: stop_suspending_while_visible
method.description: Stops watching this menu and recomputes suspension immediately.

method.name: suspend_while_visible
method.description: Neutralizes gameplay input and releases capture while this Control is visible in the tree. Watches compose. Hiding or removing the final active menu can restore the prior pointer lease when focus still permits it. The menu must be in the same viewport.

method.name: vector
method.description: Returns this physics tick's normalized two-dimensional level, limited to magnitude one. Unavailable and differently typed actions read as zero.

signal.name: retired
signal.description: Emitted once when the attachment retires and the handle stops routing input.

signal.name: suspension_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the effective suspension state changes and pending input has been cleared.
